<!--
harmonize_trial_dataset() code for the second "Harmonizing a single dataset"
slide. Pulled into the deck with an include shortcode pointing at this file.
code-line-numbers drives the incremental reveal.
-->
```{.r style="width: 80%; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 1.2em;" code-line-numbers="1,2|3,4|6-8|9-12"}
harmonize_trial_dataset <- function(dataset_name,
                                    dataset_source_files){
  dataset_data_model <- read_data_model(dataset_name)
  dataset_config <- read_harmonization_config(dataset_name)

  harmonized_dataset_files <- purrr::map(
    dataset_source_files,
    \(x) harmonize_trial_file(x, dataset_config))
  # Because primary keys are always included, we can
  # use a full_join to combine multiple source files
  harmonized_dataset <- purrr::reduce(
    harmonized_dataset_files, full_join)
}
```
